requirements: R1: The application backend must start successfully without Flyway validation errors about missing local migrations.

slices.title: Resolve Flyway Validation Error for Missing Migration
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to resolve the Flyway validation failure, so that the backend application starts successfully and passes health checks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a local database with applied migration 20260904202315126,
When the Spring Boot backend initializes,
Then Flyway validation passes and the application starts successfully.
Given the fix is implemented,
When backend integration tests are executed,
Then the tests pass successfully verifying the context initialization without Flyway errors.
